name: Tooki Kuzuha
source: Roka's 'mother', her predecessor as the manifestation of the legends of the nine-tailed fox. Similar to legend, she is a mature, beautiful woman with a tendency to tempt and tease. She adores Roka as her daughter and spoils her without end. She works making clothes and [spoiler]writing sexual how-to books for the various forms of deities in the world of the gods.[/spoiler] She happily accepts Takuto and Shiina into her home, watching over them with Roka with a gentle smile on her face.
